question: Where can I get a list of battery storage (BESS) installations in operation in the United States, with location, power (MW), energy (MWh), operator and commissioning date?

answer.summary: EIA publishes a complete official inventory of battery generators at plants of 1 MW or more. The monthly EIA-860M (September 2026) lists 1,147 operating battery generator records at 1,090 plants (56,082 MW; 154,260 MWh) with operator (Entity Name), plant coordinates, MW, MWh and operating month/year. The annual EIA-860 energy-storage schedule adds charge/discharge rates and flags for coupling and for direct support of another unit, which separate standalone from co-located batteries. No other source with comparable coverage was usable.
main_caveats: The unit is the generator record, not the installation: one plant (e.g. Moss Landing) has several battery records; sum by Plant ID to get an installation.
Plants below 1 MW total nameplate are not covered; 483 planned battery records (64,235 MW) are in a separate 'Planned' sheet and must be excluded.
EIA-860M is preliminary and corrected without notice; EIA-860 2025 final holds 1,003 battery records (43,643 MW, 121,045 MWh).
Standalone vs co-located: only EIA-860 annual flags it (379 of 1,003 records are 'Direct Support of Another Unit'); EIA-860M has no such flag.
MWh is reported by operators and is not checked against any independent source; one record (Viejas Microgrid, 17.5 MW) has no MWh.
Coordinates are one plant point shared by all generators of a plant; the public GESDB and OpenStreetMap could not be used.
answer.confidence_reason: EIA-860M and EIA-860 files were downloaded and parsed on 2026-11-19; totals, duplicates by plant and Moss Landing were reproduced; two other sources failed.

attributes.note: EIA-860M Latitude/Longitude per generator (a plant point, 4-6 decimals); EIA-860 Plant sheet gives address and county.
Nameplate MW per generator; EIA-860 adds Maximum Charge Rate and Maximum Discharge Rate (MW).
'Nameplate Energy Capacity (MWh)' reported per battery record: 1,146 of 1,147 in EIA-860M.
EIA 'Entity/Utility Name' = company responsible for day-to-day operation of the generator.
Operating Month and Operating Year present for all 1,147 operating battery records.

how_to_use.example_request: Download september_generator2026.xlsx; sheet 'Operating'; filter Technology = 'Batteries' and Plant ID = 260.
how_to_use.example_result: Dynegy Moss Landing Power Plant Hybrid (Monterey CA, 36.804837,-121.7822), operator Dynegy -Moss Landing LLC: BAT2 100 MW/400 MWh (May 2021) and BAT3 350 MW/1,400 MWh (June 2023).
steps: Filter Technology = Batteries and Status = '(OP) Operating' for equipment in service.
Group by Plant ID to get installations.
reading_traps: Records in OS/OA/SB are not all in service (22 of 1,147).
One plant point per plant, shared by all its generators.
A plant name containing 'Hybrid' signals co-location but EIA-860M has no coupling flag.
Links labelled Oct/Nov/Dec 2026 on the page return HTML, not XLSX.

problems: Page links labelled October-December 2026 return an HTML page (55,942 bytes, HTTP 200); September 2026 downloads correctly.
